table.retrieve:
SELECT
	supplieralias=accounts.aliasname,
	suppliername = accounts.name,
	accounts.acccode, 
	accounts.subcode , 
	accounts.name ,
	accounts.aliasname,
	accounts.openingdate ,
	suppcode,
	cp,
	address1,
	city,
	country,
	phone,
	fax,
	email,
	address2,
	suppcatcode,
	defaultgst,
	specialinstructions,
	dayslimit,
	salestaxregno,
	ntnno,
	supplier.countycode,
	supplier.postcode,
	supplier.CNIC ,
	supplier.MobileNo ,
	supplier.WebSiteAdd ,
	supplier.Phone2 ,
	supplier.EMAIL2 ,
	supplier.EMAIL3 ,
	supplier.BankAcc,
	supplier.whperc

FROM accounts ,
	supplier     
WHERE
	( supplier.suppcode = accounts.acccode ) and 
	(supplier.suppcatcode IN (:aa_suppcatcode))
order by Accounts.name
